description: This file defines the X509Authentication interface for authenticating clients based on X.509 certificates in the Eclipse Hono project. It declares a method for validating a certificate path with support for async handling and tracing context.

classes.name: X509Authentication
classes.description: An interface that defines the strategy for authenticating clients based on X.509 certificates. It includes a method to validate a certificate chain asynchronously, with tracing context support.

methods.name: validateClientCertificate
methods.description: Validates a client certificate chain asynchronously. Takes a certificate chain and an optional tracing span context, returning a Future with a JSON object containing authentication details if validation succeeds, or a failed Future with an exception otherwise.
